title: Require Artifact File Shape
forbids: artifact owner files outside their closed source, dependency, and validation-authority shape
why: Artifact owners define immutable MapGen data products. Grit requires the canonical Schema/artifact/validate surface and its complete legal dependency and export classes. Core then proves exact factory, schema, validator, and runtime-export identity for every registered artifact module. Shared domain vocabulary remains independent of artifact admission under the owning domain model.
remediate: In *.artifact.ts, export only Schema, artifact, validate, and erased TypeScript types; bind validate directly to artifact with defineArtifactValidator. Keep artifact-local checks private, never reimplement structural TypeBox admission, and import genuinely shared schema primitives from the owning domain's public model/schemas surface.
message: Artifact owner files must retain their closed schema-bound source and dependency shape.
